subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose update execution to gateway-authenticated HTTP callers, and if so should that be a dedicated `/admin/update` contract or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The request would grant network callers host package-update and restart authority, while current code treats `update.run` as an operator-admin control-plane write and the existing Admin HTTP RPC plugin intentionally omits it.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep the version field in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-owned API/security design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` or a wrapper to the default-off Admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit private-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, and handoff proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane surfaces and tell fleet tools to use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep the version field in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-owned API/security design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across Admin HTTP RPC, version resolution, and update-run stabilization.
